background: Skipton Building Society is one of the largest UK building societies, a mutual funded by retail savings and lending on residential mortgages, and the owner of the Connells estate-agency group.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the society, at A on average and both on a stable outlook, with the last move a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. Capital is a clear strength against UK building societies, with CET1 of 27.9% and leverage of 6.7% both in the top quarter. Liquidity is the weaker side, with LCR of 178% below the peer median and NSFR of 137% in the bottom quarter, and since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.9 points and LCR 14 points with the rest flat. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days; very well capitalised, with liquidity ratios lower than most of its peers.
